name: Live Matches
description: Streamed.pk, PPV.to, and CDN Live in one PlayTorrio-style Jellyfin channel.
overview: Provider folders: Streamed.pk (Live / Today / All), PPV.to (categories), CDN Live (channels + sports). Configure feeds under the plugin settings.

versions.changelog: Live playback: browser Referer/User-Agent for ffmpeg, longer HLS probe, disable HLS direct-play (remux/transcode), richer embed URL extraction.
Fix channel playback: MediaSource Id now matches Jellyfin item id (fixes empty playback / wrong screen).
Catalog release: Streamed.pk, PPV.to, CDN Live; Jellyfin plugin repository support.
